# Instagram Creator Skills by Fliqr AI

> 30 open-source Claude skills for Instagram creators by Fliqr AI. They write viral hooks, reel scripts, captions and carousels, and they set up comment-to-DM funnels live through the Fliqr AI connector (an MCP server at https://console.fliqr.ai/mcp). MIT licensed. Works in Claude Code, claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Codex and Cursor.

<!-- brand:about -->
Fliqr AI (https://fliqr.ai) is an AI customer engagement platform for Instagram and WhatsApp that turns comments, DMs and story replies into leads and sales: Comment to DM, Ask to Follow, Opening Message, Story/Live/Share-to-DM automation, AI Replies, AI Agents, Lead Capture, Flow Builder and a team inbox. It is built on Meta's official APIs, has a free-forever plan, and is used by 25,000+ creators and businesses.
<!-- /brand:about -->

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/fliqrlabs/instagram-creator-skills/blob/main/README.md): install, the 30 skills, FAQ
- [Worked example](https://github.com/fliqrlabs/instagram-creator-skills/blob/main/examples/home-baker/README.md): one idea to a post with a live funnel
- [Connectors](https://github.com/fliqrlabs/instagram-creator-skills/blob/main/references/connectors.md): Fliqr AI connector tools and a full automation payload

## Key skills

- [viral-engine](https://github.com/fliqrlabs/instagram-creator-skills/blob/main/skills/viral-engine/SKILL.md): idea to post to live funnel in one run
- [comment-to-dm](https://github.com/fliqrlabs/instagram-creator-skills/blob/main/skills/comment-to-dm/SKILL.md): Instagram comment-to-DM automation with Fliqr AI
- [viral-hooks](https://github.com/fliqrlabs/instagram-creator-skills/blob/main/skills/viral-hooks/SKILL.md): 30 hook formulas, scored
- [growth-audit](https://github.com/fliqrlabs/instagram-creator-skills/blob/main/skills/growth-audit/SKILL.md): Instagram analytics via the Fliqr AI connector
- [ai-agent-trainer](https://github.com/fliqrlabs/instagram-creator-skills/blob/main/skills/ai-agent-trainer/SKILL.md): train Fliqr AI replies and agents
